name: Mount Bromo
blurb: Located in East Java, Indonesia, Mount Bromo is an active volcano within Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park known for its scenic sunrises and sand sea caldera. Recent discussions center around wildfires affecting the area and temporary park closures.

positive: Appreciated for stunning sunrise and landscape views
Popular subject for photography and art
negative: Wildfires spreading in the national park

#Indonesia: Mount Bromo is an active volcano, and is a popular tourist destination and best known for its "sand sea" caldera.

Indonesia closes Mount Bromo national park as firefighters struggle to contain a wildfire that has razed approximately 176 hectares in East Java.

Indonesia has closed all tourist access to Mount Bromo, one of its most visited volcanoes, after a wildfire in its caldera expanded from 60 to 176 hectares in two days. Water-bombing helicopters and drones are deployed, with no set reopening date. Source: Reuters, ANTARA News.

“That blaze broke out when a couple lit a flare during a pre-wedding photo shoot and destroyed more than 500 hectares of land.“ Indonesia battles Mount Bromo wildfire as El Nino takes root Indonesia battles Mount Bromo wildfire as El Nino takes root www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/20...
